title: refactor: clarify balance deduction pipeline
author: voodoohop
pr_body_excerpt:
- Extracts the billing flow into named resolve, compute, deduct, and credit steps.
- Deduplicates developer and community-owner credit handling without changing execution order.
- Preserves SQL, balance thresholds, rounding, errors, logging, and return shapes.
- Documents the authoritative deduction ladder and separates it from preflight/reporting behavior.

Checks:
- `npm run typecheck` (gen.pollinations.ai)
- `npm run test` — 104 files passed; 1,248 tests passed, 6 skipped
- `npx biome check --write shared/billing/bucket-selection.ts shared/billing/deduction.ts shared/billing/track-helpers.ts`

gist.headline: The billing ladder gets labels
gist.blurb: The hive’s credit path has been untangled into named steps, with the same math and the same landing spot. Less spelunking through billing code; more knowing which rung you are on.
gist.summary: Refactored the shared billing deduction pipeline into explicit resolve, compute, deduct, and credit steps while preserving SQL behavior, balance thresholds, rounding, errors, logging, return shapes, and execution order.
gist.impact: Developers now have a documented authoritative deduction ladder and deduplicated developer/community-owner credit handling, making billing behavior easier to trace without changing account balances or request outcomes.
gist.visual_concept: A cozy garden-shed billing workshop where Polli carefully climbs a labeled four-rung ladder—resolve, compute, deduct, credit—toward neatly sorted Pollen jars. A friendly CRT monitor robot holds a blueprint of the deduction path, while code-plants and small flowers show that the underlying system is unchanged but easier to navigate.
